details:
OK I don't think this bug report went through the first time, so I'm retyping all of this. Appologies if it did and I just can't see it.

Using meta quest link with quest 2 controllers and headset and running vrchat through the meta quest link app, so steamvr is not part of the issue.

When using my custom bindings in the "controls" section of the main menu settings, I am unable to use the quick menu. The quick menu in my custom bindings is bound to the B and Y buttons just like the default settings. This means that I also cannot close the main menu while it is open. I can rejoin the world or join another world to get out of the main menu and all the other bindings will work just fine, only the quick menu doesn't work.

The other bindings options in the menu seem to work fine, so I can at least use those for now. It is a little annoying to not have the bindings I am used to though.
title: Quick menu bind does not work on meta vrchat using custom bindings
